messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for inference-gateway-prod — 5xx error rate > 12% (5m window) in region us-west1. Incident PDINC-81234. https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PDINC-81234 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident created and assigned to rotation 'oncall-sre'. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/inference-5xx — priority: P1

Alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, joining zoom. ETA 5m.

Ben (sre): On standby. Can you check LB and kv-proxy evictions? I'll look at autoscaler history.

Alice (oncall): Quick grep from proxy hosts shows a flurry of 502s + kvcache evict spikes. Snippet:
``
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] proxy nginx: 502 upstream timed out while reading response
[2026-03-17T02:15:13Z] kvcache: evict_count=348 free_mem=120MB
[2026-03-17T02:15:14Z] proxy nginx: 502 upstream connection reset
``

Carla (eng-runtime): That pattern looks like kvcache OOM/eviction cascade. No deploys in last hour. Could be sudden token/batch size shift or bad prefix warmup.

David (product): Any immediate customer impact? Which routes/customers affected?

Eva (ops): Dashboard snapshot: overall failed requests ~0.8% of total, but route /v1/generate for acct:acme-corp shows ~15% failures. CS alerted for acme-corp.

Alice (oncall): Short-term mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to model-variant 'redwood-small-v1' for latency-sensitive requests, 2) scale dedicated pool in us-west1 +2 nodes, 3) throttle long-running prefixes. Applying in that order now.

Ben (sre): Scaling command issued: `rctl scale dedicated-usw1 --add 2` — returned OK. Monitoring node join and LB rebalancing.

incident-bot: Applied routing policy: route /v1/generate weight fallback->redwood-small-v1=0.35 for high-latency clients. Cache-warm job queued.

Alice (oncall): Fallback in place and cache warming kicked off. Early metrics: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 4% in 4 minutes. Continuing to watch for 15m.

David (product): Good. CS will send an interim status to affected customers (acme-corp). Please record timelines for postmortem.

Carla (eng-runtime): I'll pull kv-proxy heap dumps and tracer spans for affected window. Putting commands here: `kubectl exec -c kvproxy pod/kv-xxx -- pmap` and `curl http://trace-collector/query?start=...&end=...`

Eva (ops): Noted. I'll keep CS looped and prepare incident banner if error rate creeps back up.

Ben (sre): Still seeing a few slow sockets on older model hosts; might be transient GC. Collecting `dmesg` and jstack from model workers.

Alice (oncall): Stabilized to ~3% over 10 minutes. Setting a 30m watch; will hand off to next oncall at 1751115600. If stable, we'll mark SEV reduced and kick off RCA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, mitigation_actions=[fallback routing, scaled dedicated pool], severity=P1->P2 (monitoring).

David (product): Thanks team. Filing postmortem ticket and tagging involved owners.

Ben (sre): I'll upload logs and metric graphs to the ticket in ~45m.

Alice (oncall): Closing active paging for now, keeping channel open for notes.
